options.title: Airbnb Was Kept Alive by Election Cereal
options.first_line: Airbnb stayed alive in two thousand eight by selling election cereal.
options.first_frame: A US election ballot on a desk, then a cut to a box of cereal with the Airbnb logo beside it.

why: It names a famous business and raises a real how-is-that-possible question (what is election cereal, and how did it keep Airbnb alive?) without giving the answer away, while A and B hand over the cereal-box price up front.
